name: ghoul-deps
description: Meta-port that pulls in every third-party dependency of Ghoul without building Ghoul itself.

Use this in a superproject (such as OpenSpace) that consumes Ghoul through add_subdirectory and therefore needs Ghoul's dependencies in its own manifest, because vcpkg only reads the manifest of the top-level project.
The dependency list is kept in sync with the root vcpkg.json of Ghoul by support/vcpkg/check-manifest-sync.cmake.
Note that `overrides` cannot be expressed in a port, so the superproject manifest must repeat the `overrides` entries from Ghoul's vcpkg.json.
